title: Smith eval record launch log line (format version 1, frozen in slice 1a)
description: One line of segments.jsonl per launch of an eval run: the first start, each resume after a kill, and each 'run the failed trials again' (slice 1b.2). Trial lines name the segment that wrote them.

purpose.description: start (the first launch), resume (after an interruption; nothing recorded runs again), rerun_errors (an actor asked to run again the trials whose effective line ended in error; slice 1b.2). Closed list within format 1.

request_key.description: For rerun_errors, the request's idempotency key: the same key never runs the trials twice. Null otherwise.

resumed.description: True when purpose is resume (kept for readers of the first draft).

trials_already_recorded.description: Trials with a final line when this launch began; none of them runs again.
